title: Trump's October rally claims: what the evidence says
claim: A series of claims at October 2026 campaign rallies
summary: FactCheck.org reviewed more than a dozen false, misleading or exaggerated claims across multiple rallies. This is a sourced roundup, not a single-claim verdict.

title: Record number of Americans working — with a catch
claim: More Americans are working than ever before
summary: FactCheck.org says the raw employment count was at a high, but so was the population. The employment-to-population ratio was below its January 2025 level.

title: Zero illegal immigrants admitted? The missing distinction
claim: In the past 17 months, zero illegal aliens have been admitted to the United States
summary: The claim appears to refer to releases at the southern border, not to all unauthorized entries or successful crossings.

title: A 97% fall in drugs smuggled by sea? Not established
claim: We brought the flow of deadly drugs coming in by ocean down by 97%
summary: No comprehensive dataset measures all illicit drugs entering by sea, including drugs not seized. The cited seizure comparison is selective.

title: No tax on tips, overtime or Social Security? Read the fine print
claim: No tax on tips, no tax on overtime, no tax on Social Security
summary: The provisions are limited by caps, income thresholds and expiration dates. The Social Security-related provision is a deduction for eligible older taxpayers, not elimination of all benefit taxation.

title: Can tariffs fund $5,000 checks for every adult?
claim: Tariff revenue could fund $5,000 payments to all adult citizens
summary: FactCheck.org cites estimates that the proposed payments would cost around $1.2 trillion, many years of tariff receipts at current levels.

title: The 'greatest economy' claim meets GDP data
claim: We had the greatest economy in the history of our country
summary: FactCheck.org reports that real GDP growth in Trump's first term did not exceed many earlier years' growth rates.

title: $21 trillion in investment? The accounting is missing
claim: We have $21 trillion being invested in our country
summary: FactCheck.org reports that no full accounting supports this figure; announced commitments include speculative plans.

title: Worst inflation ever inherited? Historical figures disagree
claim: I inherited the worst inflation in American history
summary: FactCheck.org notes much higher historical inflation and reports annual inflation at 3.0% when Trump took office in January 2025.

title: Record-low poverty? Depends on the measure
claim: The poverty rate has just reached its lowest level
summary: The official poverty rate reached a record low in 2025, but the supplemental poverty measure was higher than in some previous years.

title: The $20 trillion foreign-investment assertion
claim: An unprecedented $20 trillion has been invested in the U.S. from outside countries and companies
summary: FactCheck.org found the $20 trillion figure unsupported.

title: Did thousands cheer in New Jersey on 9/11?
claim: I watched in Jersey City, N.J., where thousands and thousands of people were cheering
summary: Independent investigations found no evidence for the thousands-strong celebrations in New Jersey described by Trump.
